title: Know What You Don't Know: Agentic Data Synthesis by Evolving Generation Space for Closed-Loop Learning
description:
arXiv:2610.12593v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The continued improvement of large language models increasingly depends on synthetic experience, yet effective data synthesis for interactive agents requires not only executable and verifiable trajectories, but also interactions that provide learning value for the current task agent.
